sources.snippet: Gemma is a groundbreaking new open model in the Gemini family of models from Google. Gemma is just as powerful as previous models but compact enough to run locally on NVIDIA RTX GPUs. Gemma is available in 2 sizes: 2B and 7B parameters. With NVIDIA NeMo, you can customize Gemma to fit your usecase and deploy an optimized model on your NVIDIA GPU.
